cases.prompt: The daily reminder job gets slower every week as loans pile up. Find out why and fix it.
Which HTTP endpoints does this service expose? List each one with its method and path.
Two members sometimes check out the last copy of the same title at the same moment, and both checkouts succeed. Fix it so that cannot happen, including any database change it needs.
cases.review: The answer explains the lost update: two transactions read available_copies = 1 and both write 0, and the CHECK (available_copies >= 0) in V1__init.sql cannot catch it. It fixes it with an optimistic lock (@Version on Book and a new V3__ migration adding the version column NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), an atomic conditional update, or a pessimistic lock, and maps the losing request to 409 (or retries it) through ApiErrorHandler. It adds a test that proves the second checkout fails, edits neither V1 nor V2, and gives the test command as not run.
